notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result, "silent-hill-townfall-2" (id 1018062, released 2026-09-23, Screen Burn, published by Konami and Annapurna Interactive), matches the expected slug. No StrategyWiki page under "Silent Hill: Townfall" or "Silent Hill Townfall". silenthill.fandom.com answers the API under "Silent Hill: Townfall", with about 71 linked pages, including "St. Amelia", "Simon Ordell", "Zoe Ellis" and "CRTV"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Cannula" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1636440 as "SILENT HILL: Townfall". 28 of 36 Steam achievements are hidden, the highest share in this batch; they all sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. Nine fall from 90% ("Welcome To St. Amelia") to 38% ("Eraser") and look like story steps; many others sit near 3 to 5% and may be endings or optional feats, but their conditions are secret, so the story chapter holds far more than story alone. Only 8 achievements are visible, so there are only four chapters.
